requirements.label: Prerequisite: Completion of the LSA Language Requirement
requirements.hint: One 4th term course required, C- minimum, or one course where proficiency is presumed.

requirements.label: Core Translation Courses: 2 of COMPLIT 200, 250, 322, 323, 494
requirements.hint: At least 2 Comparative Literature core translation courses, 6 credits. Choose from: COMPLIT 200 (Translation Across Disciplines), COMPLIT 250 (Translating Race and Ethnicity in Local and Global Contexts), COMPLIT 322 (Translating World Literatures), COMPLIT 323 (Adapting World Literatures), COMPLIT 494 (Translation Practicum). C- or better. Must be taken on the Ann Arbor campus.

requirements.label: COMPLIT 497: Translation Capstone Seminar
requirements.hint: Translation Capstone Project, 3 credits. C- or better.

requirements.label: Upper-Level Language Courses: minimum 3 courses, 9 credits
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. A minimum of three upper-level language courses beyond the LSA Language Requirement, 9 credits, C- or better, with content designed to engage students with language fluency. The department publishes no fixed course list for this part of the major; if availability of upper-level courses in a language is limited, students may propose alternative plans for approval in consultation with the undergraduate advisor, per the LSA bulletin Translation major page (effective Winter 2026). Until then, confirm progress with your advisor.

requirements.label: Language and Translation Electives: 18 Total Credits
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. Language and Translation Electives total 18 credits, C- or better: at least 9 credits of upper-level language courses beyond the LSA Language Requirement, plus courses related to language and/or translation at the 200 level or above in any department, chosen from the Comparative Literature department's list Pre-Approved Courses for the Major in Translation (Google Sheet linked from the department's Translation major degree requirements page), or approved by the Director of Undergraduate Studies. The upper-level language portion has no fixed course list, so the planner cannot total the electives automatically yet. Until then, confirm progress with your advisor.

requirements.label: 6 Elective Credits Taken in Residence
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. At least 6 credits of the Language and Translation Electives must be taken in residence, on the Ann Arbor campus or through U-M study abroad, per the LSA bulletin Translation major page. Until then, confirm progress with your advisor.

requirements.label: Major Total Credits: minimum 27
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. The major requires a minimum of 27 credits, counting all courses used toward the major requirements including those from other departments, and not counting prerequisites. The elective requirements accept upper-level language courses and Director of Undergraduate Studies approved courses with no fixed published list, so the planner cannot total the major automatically yet. Until then, confirm progress with your advisor.

requirements.label: Major Residency Requirement: minimum 15 credits
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. At least 15 credits counting toward the major must be taken in residence, on the Ann Arbor campus or through U-M study abroad. Until then, confirm progress with your advisor.
